PATCHWORK FIELDS AND A RED-ROOFED VILLAGE: a quilt of small fields in four greens and one gold, hedgerows drawn as neat dark lines, a toy village of red roofs around a cobbled square with a white chapel, a dirt road curving away between rounded haystacks with neat capped tops

PATCHWORK FARMS WITH A WINDMILL ON A KNOLL: broad flat farmland divided into tidy squares of green and amber, a white windmill turning on a low rise, a cluster of barns with brown roofs beside a hay yard, a lane running straight to a gate post

PATCHWORK ORCHARDS AND A STONE MILL: rows of blossom-topped orchard trees in pale pink and white, a stone water mill beside a narrow stream, low field walls of dark grey tile, a farmhouse with a vegetable patch and a small round dovecote

PATCHWORK COUNTRY WITH HAYSTACKS AND A MARKET TOWN: rolling farmland in a checkerboard of sage, lime, olive, and gold, haystacks dotting every other field, a market town of warm-red rooftops around a broad square, a canal running along the far edge with a single lock gate

HILL TOWN STACKED ON A PALE ROCK: a town climbing a steep pale rock in tight tiers, white-washed walls and terracotta roofs, a small round castle with a flag mast at the summit, switchback steps descending to an orchard grove at the base

HILL TOWN ON A DARK BASALT PLUG: a compact town of grey stone houses stacked up a sheer basalt column, a fortified gate halfway up, a bell tower at the very top, a ribbon road looping down in hairpin curves to a flat bridge below

HILL TOWN WITH A RUINED TOWER CROWN: a terraced hilltop town of sand-coloured walls, a ruined tower with broken battlements at the crest, a staircase street of tiny white steps, olive trees arranged in neat rows on the slopes surrounding the base

RIVER VALLEY WITH THREE BRIDGES: a bright ribbon river crossing the valley floor with three arched bridges in pale stone, a mill town on one bank, a ferry landing on the other, water-meadows in two shades of green between the bends

RIVER VALLEY WITH A WALLED TOWN AND WEIRS: a wide slow river dividing the land, a walled riverside town with towers and a gate, two stone weirs making small white falls, a road running in switchbacks up from the bridge to a hilltop farmstead

RIVER DELTA WITH FISH WEIRS AND A VILLAGE: a river splitting into three bright channels across a flat delta plain, fish weirs drawn as thin dark lines in the water, a village of pale roofs on a low levee, reed beds tiled in dark green at the edges

DESERT MESAS WITH AN ARCH AND A TRADING POST: flat-topped mesas in orange and rose rising from a sandy floor, a natural arch connecting two pillars, a small trading post of adobe walls in the shadow of the tallest mesa, a dry road winding between the rocks

CANYON COUNTRY WITH A CLIFF DWELLING: a deep canyon cut in candy-striped red and ochre rock, a cliff dwelling of stacked tiny rooms on a ledge halfway up the wall, a dry riverbed of pale sand below, stone towers on the canyon rim

DESERT PLATEAU WITH BUTTES AND A DUST ROAD: a wide plateau of rose-coloured rock, three rounded buttes of different heights standing apart, a long straight dust road crossing from edge to edge, a small waystation with a covered well at the crossroads in the middle

COAST WITH A LIGHTHOUSE ON A GREEN HEADLAND: a bold green headland jutting into the sea, a white lighthouse at its tip, cliff paths marked as thin pixel lines, a cove below with a stone jetty and two small fishing boats pulled up on the shingle

CLIFFED COAST WITH A HARBOUR TOWN: tall striped cliffs in grey and cream running along the shore, a harbour town tucked into a gap, a curved stone breakwater enclosing a small fleet, a road climbing the cliff face in tight zigzags to a clifftop farmstead

HEADLAND WITH A RUINED FORT AND FISHING VILLAGE: a broad green headland ending in sea stacks, a ruined coastal fort with crumbling walls at the tip, a fishing village of brightly coloured rooftops in a sheltered bay, lobster-pot rows visible on the quayside

FOREST AND ROUND LAKE WITH ONE ISLAND: a dense forest of rounded dark-green treetops surrounding a perfectly round lake, a single small island in the centre holding one tall tree, a timber jetty on the near shore, a forest track winding in from the edge

LAKE COUNTRY WITH A MILL VILLAGE: a cluster of three lakes connected by short channels, a mill village on the strip of land between two of them, a wooden bridge crossing the narrowest channel, mixed forest of round and pointed treetops filling the gaps

FOREST WITH A RUINED TOWER AND A CLEARING: a broad forest of rounded canopy tiles in four greens, a ruined stone tower rising above the treeline at the centre, a circular clearing around it with a ring of standing stones, a path cutting through the trees to a woodcutter's cottage

TERRACED RICE HILLSIDES WITH A SHRINE VILLAGE: steep hillsides carved into stacked tile-like rice terraces in pale green and blue-green, a small shrine village of dark-tiled roofs at the crest, a stepped stone path descending through the levels, tiny figures of water buffalo in the lowest fields

TERRACED VINEYARD SLOPES WITH A WALLED TOWN: a hillside of neat terraced vineyards in rows of deep green, a walled town with a church tower at the top, stone retaining walls drawn as thin dark lines between each level, a cart track switchbacking up through the vines

MOORLAND WITH STANDING STONES AND SHEEP WALLS: a broad open moor in heather-purple and bracken-brown, a circle of tall standing stones at the centre, sheep-field walls of dark dry stone dividing the lower slopes, a lone shepherd's bothy with a turf roof on a ridge

HIGH MOOR WITH STONE CIRCLES AND A DROVE ROAD: rolling moorland in olive and rust, two stone circles of different sizes visible from above, a long straight drove road of pale stone crossing the moor from wall to wall, a small pack-horse bridge over a peaty stream

LAGOON WITH SMALL ISLANDS AND STILT VILLAGES: a wide shallow lagoon in turquoise and teal, three small vegetated islands with stilt-house villages connected by narrow wooden walkways, fishing platforms on stilted frames scattered across the open water, a channel marked with wooden poles leading to the shore

SNOWY FOOTHILLS WITH A TIMBER VILLAGE: low rounded foothills covered in snow-dusted pine forest, a timber village of log buildings with steep pitched roofs around a central fire hall, a frozen stream crossed by a single plank bridge, a logging track running up into the treeline
